crossRefs.note: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,
Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.
translations.bsb: Now Rachel had taken Laban’s household idols, put them in the saddlebag of her camel, and was sitting on them. And Laban searched everything in the tent but found nothing.
translations.kjv: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found
translations.asv: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, and put them in the camel's saddle, and sat upon them. And Laban felt about all the tent, but found them not.
